page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor featuring 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 372.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the instance bundles four NVIDIA T4 GPUs from the Turing architecture, delivering a combined 64 GB of VRAM. It features a KVM hypervisor, 30 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, and contains no local storage.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.89 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.2 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded performance is strong, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 70574.45 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 287.37 GB/sec. Memory performance is robust for cached operations, reaching a read-only small block bandwidth of 3924.63 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write speeds remain average at 147.24 GB/sec and 58.43 GB/sec respectively. Additionally, the instance demonstrates high efficiency in key-value operations, achieving 64.27 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its lack of local storage and its modest single-core CPU speeds, which may limit performance in sequential, non-parallelized tasks. However, the high density of dedicated CPU cores, combined with four NVIDIA T4 GPUs and 30 Gbps network bandwidth, makes it highly cost-efficient for parallel processing workloads relative to its hardware class. This server is best suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, parallel data processing, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and high-throughput Redis deployments.
